tools.name: create_knowledge_test
tools.description: Create an online knowledge test (exam-style quiz with scoring) on Wellemo from questions you write, and get a link to share. Participants take it in the browser without registration; the author sees every result, score and the hardest questions. Returns: take_url (public, send it to participants), e

tools.name: get_test_results
tools.description: Get a summary of results for a Wellemo knowledge test: number of participants, average score, pass rate, average time and the questions people got wrong most often. Needs the private edit_url (or its id) returned by create_knowledge_test. Participant names are not returned; full results are at resul

tools.name: search_tests
tools.description: Search the public Wellemo catalog of ready-made tests and quizzes by topic. Returns titles, short descriptions, number of takes and a link to take each test on Wellemo. Questions are not returned: give the user the links.
